description: This PHP class represents a web service API model within the AWS SDK for PHP, providing methods for configuring, accessing, and managing service operations, metadata, and protocols.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a web service API model, providing access to operations, metadata, protocols, and configuration details for AWS services.

methods.name: createSerializer
methods.description: Creates a request serializer for the given API object based on its protocol.

methods.name: createErrorParser
methods.description: Creates an error parser for a specified protocol.

methods.name: createParser
methods.description: Creates and applies client model parser listeners based on protocol.

methods.name: getServiceFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the service.

methods.name: getServiceId
methods.description: Returns the service ID.

methods.name: getApiVersion
methods.description: Returns the API version used by the service.

methods.name: getEndpointPrefix
methods.description: Returns the endpoint prefix of the service.

methods.name: getSigningName
methods.description: Returns the signing name used by the service.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the service name.

methods.name: getSignatureVersion
methods.description: Returns the default signature version, typically 'v4'.

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol used by the service.

methods.name: getUid
methods.description: Returns the UID used by the service.

methods.name: hasOperation
methods.description: Checks if a specific operation exists by name.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific operation by name, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Returns all operations of the service.

methods.name: getErrorShapes
methods.description: Returns all error shape definitions of the service.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves the full metadata or a specific metadata value.

methods.name: getPaginators
methods.description: Retrieves available paginators configurations.

methods.name: hasPaginator
methods.description: Checks if a paginator exists by name.

methods.name: getPaginatorConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for a specific paginator.

methods.name: getWaiters
methods.description: Retrieves available waiter configurations.

methods.name: hasWaiter
methods.description: Checks if a waiter exists by name.

methods.name: getWaiterConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a specific waiter configuration.

methods.name: getShapeMap
methods.description: Returns the shape map used by the API.

methods.name: getClientContextParams
methods.description: Returns context parameters for the client.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the API provider callback.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns the service's API definition.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets or updates the API definition, marking the model as modified.

methods.name: isModifiedModel
methods.description: Indicates whether the model has been modified.
